newsitem.title: USA: Deluxe buys collections company, sells unit.
newsitem.headline: Deluxe buys collections company, sells unit.

text.p: Deluxe Corp said Thursday its National Revenue Corp subsidiary recently acquired National Credit Services for undisclosed terms.

Deluxe also said it completed the sale of its Deluxe U.K. Ltd subsidiary. It sold the forms portion of this business to Deluxe U.K. management but is retaining its PaperDirect and check business in the United Kingdom. It did not disclose terms.

National Credit Services, headquartered in Gaithersburg, Md., provides collections services to the bank card, retail and telecommunications industries. In 1995, it reported $300 million in credit collection placements.
